validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 QEMU C6 guest 内通过 135x240 显示、触摸/按键、PI4IOE、BQ27220/AW32001、BMI270、SX1262 LoRa、RMT 红外、I2S 蜂鸣器、QEMU ESP32-C6 WiFi DHCP/HTTP、example.com IPv4 DNS/HTTP 和 UART1 HCI BLE NUS；独立 runner 与 Device Service 单个 qemu-unified lease 均通过，stock hardware.RGB() 仍为 NOT RUN。RUNTIME-01 已定位为 16 MiB Flash legacy 写擦地址宽度和复位 PMP 状态问题并修复：Meshtastic 经 Device Service 重跑不再报 Invalid chip id，但仍存在独立的 Instruction access fault，因此完整功能仍为 PARTIAL。

官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 QEMU C6 guest 内通过 hardware.RGB/WS2812、GPIO9 按键、GPIO7 蓝色 LED、RMT NEC 红外、QEMU ESP32-C6 WiFi 扫描/关联/DHCP/HTTP 和 UART1 HCI BLE NUS；独立 runner、公网探针和 Device Service 单个 qemu-unified lease 均通过。跨厂商公开固件审查另记录 Zigbee/802.15.4 controller 未建模（RUNTIME-02）；这不否定已通过的基线外设/WiFi/BLE 路径。

validation.ack_observability: Patch 0010 preserves opt-in ACK-state observability. In the historical zero-stagger five-instance diagnostic, the first Reset Complete response-to-HLI timestamp delta was 4.506306s of host trace time, not guest virtual time; at the first ACK check ack=NULL and semaphore count 0.
validation.concurrency_validation: Two independent two-instance no-stagger 4x120s gates pass 8/8, two independent three-instance 3x120s gates pass 6/6, and two independent four-instance 4x120s gates pass 8/8. Patch 0008 preallocates real guest HCI-event buffers and ACL mbufs while CPU0 is idle; patch 0009 expands the real reserve to 8 event/4 ACL objects after the initial four-instance gate failed 1/4. Every passing lease records 36 events/9 ACLs on the fast path, HLI 45/45, hli-errors=0 and the expected spare depth. Two independent five-instance 5x120s batches with a 30-second startup stagger pass 10/10. The earlier shift=auto zero-stagger implementation remained unstable: one batch passed 5/5 and an independent confirmation failed 3/5; trace showed interrupt masking during PSRAM init plus host-contention-stretched virtual time delayed HLI beyond the NimBLE ACK window. The current default fixes icount shift=5 and starts the test BLE server before WiFi/PSRAM work. Two independent zero-stagger five-instance 5x120s batches pass 10/10 and two zero-stagger six-instance 6x120s batches pass 12/12. An eight-instance 8x120s control under the former hold/10 floor failed 4/8 only on the PSRAM sweep count: all eight guests passed WiFi/public HTTP, NUS GATT, frame, 31-node QOM, pcap/evidence with zero HLI/reset/panic, while four leases completed 11 contiguous sweeps instead of 12. The failure is retained. After calibrating the fixed-clock sustained floor to hold/12, two independent zero-stagger eight-instance 8x120s batches pass 8/8 each (16/16 total) at the service per-device cap of 8; every lease completes 11-12 PSRAM readback sweeps, with one recoverable prealloc transient per batch. The reconnect contract remains 1-121 with 122 rejected. More than eight instances, sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop remain OPEN.
validation.memory_validation: The m5core2 machine now exposes a QOM-effective 8 MiB PSRAM device. Normal ESP32 DRAM1 remains a 4 MiB directly mapped heap window; a dedicated ESP-IDF esp_himem probe passed in three independent Device Service leases, mapping two different 32 KiB physical blocks through the same virtual MMU window and verifying both after remap (4,456,448 bytes himem capacity, 262,144-byte reserve). Guest sustained stress remains PASS in three independent 120-second leases (35/35/35 checks, 105 MiB total) and one 600-second lease (179 checks). Physical PSRAM/cache timing remains NOT RUN.
validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 m5core2 guest 内通过 320x240 显示/触摸、AXP2101、INA3221、MPU6886、PCF8563、NS4168 扬声器、SPM1423 麦克风、OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP、example.com IPv4 DNS/HTTP 和 stock firmware 外部 BLE GATT。规范 Device Service profile `core2-native-hci` 已通过 HCI-4、121 轮重连、active-BLE 长稳、active-stop、bounded TCG 和当前服务容量内的零错峰并发。最终 `tb-size=128` 两小时复测绑定 firmware/ELF/QEMU/工具哈希，RSS 323536→252992 KiB、phys footprint 250880→188416 KiB。四实例首批失败保留，扩为 8 event/4 ACL 后关闭；旧 `shift=auto` 五实例失败 control 保留，固定 `shift=5` 与 BLE-first 后两批六实例为 12/12。当前服务上限八实例在 `hold/12` 校准后两批均为 8/8，合计 16/16；manifest/capability/security 更新后，该门禁又按当前工具哈希重绑。m5core2 machine 现以 8 MiB PSRAM device 和 DRAM1 32 KiB MMU 页映射运行；三个独立 esp_himem lease、三个 120 秒 guest PSRAM 压力和一次 600 秒联网压力均 PASS。legacy UIFlow 的 shared I2C、equal-deadline timer、TIMG WDT mask、QIO/stateful SSI、统一 handoff timeline、exact-time pause/state sweep、setter trace、WDT liveness 和 WDT-off late-state 对照均已形成可重放证据。0064 修复 pending SPI source 在 interrupt-matrix remap 后不投递的通用缺陷；同一 ESP-IDF SPI3 probe 由 pre-fix callback timeout 变为 fixed PASS，Core2 UIFlow2 设备组 6/6 PASS。BIN-bound 分析把 WDT-off 约 44 秒后的 CPU1 等待绑定到 LVGL `lv_refr_vdb_flush`：display flush callback 已执行，但最新 legacy runtime 仍未到达 SPI completion callback 和 `lv_disp_flush_ready`，仍由 reset/stop 阻断非空帧。旧 `core2-native-vhci` 仅保留为 GDB 诊断/兼容路径。2026-10-29 的 0085 另以锁定确定性测试 config 关闭 Core2 for AWS ATECC608 初始化/identity 缺口，并修正 classic ESP32 DMA link-start/DC；公开固件三次通过 nonempty frame，但不代表 ECDSA、生产 trust root、电气或真机 PASS。物理 cache/PSRAM、大于当前服务容量、持续吞吐、其他 teardown 模式、legacy 非空应用帧与 Espressif BT baseband/controller bit-exact 执行仍未完成。

validation.detail: UIFlow2 P4 firmware boots with the C6 ESP-Hosted bridge, renders a physical 1280x720 landscape frame through the real M5GFX drawing path, and redraws after touch. Tab5 I2C reaches G31/G32 through the P4 controller: INA226 preload reaches Power as 8000mV/1248mA/87%, machine.RTC writes and reads RX8130, both PI4IOE IDs/output writeback pass, and CHG_STAT=0x00/0x40 reaches Power.isCharging() as charging/discharging. SIT3088 RS-485 passes through UART1 G20/G21 and direction G34. BMI270 identity, dynamic I2C/time injection, IP2326 analog current/termination behavior and the remaining native P4 data planes remain partial.

validation.detail: 官方 CardputerZero ARM64 镜像以 512 MiB RAM 启动；ST7789v3 的 DRM/fb1 路径输出 320x170 RGB565 帧，QMP TCA8418 事件经 BCM GPIO27 中断进入 Linux input。TCA8418、M5IOE1、BMI270、BMM150、RX8130、BQ27220 和 ES8389 均绑定到 Linux 驱动；ES8389 I2C ID/状态、ALSA 播放 PCM、麦克风 PCM 逐字节回放和 AW8737A GPIO24 使能通过；IP2315 QOM 电源路径注入使 BQ27220/Linux status 从 Charging 切换为 Discharging；GL852G MTT 兼容路径同时完成 SR9900A Full-Speed 以太网帧回环和 Low-Speed HID 枚举/输入，r8152 创建 eth0；QMP GPIO13 波形经 Linux LIRC 收到 mode2 数据，GPIO12 NEC 发送边沿可抓取；IMX219 寄存器驱动 Unicam CSI1 完成 640x480 RG10 V4L2 实帧与 V4L2 控制项验证；官方 factory_test 的 LVGL 320x170 首帧通过 fb1 验证，54400/54400 个像素非黑、127 种 RGB565 颜色，画面哈希在 UI 启动后发生变化。
